title: MemeCULT-1K：南亚文化语境与幽默理解多模态模型基准测试
summary: MemeCULT-1K是一个包含1000个南亚多语言模因（孟加拉语、英语、印地语）的基准数据集，每个模因配有文化背景注释和人工解释。评估13个视觉语言模型发现，提供文化上下文可显著提升性能（SBERT相似度+11.8）。错误分析显示闭源模型主要失败于实体识别，开源模型受文化知识差距限制。
summary_en: MemeCULT-1K is a benchmark of 1,000 South Asian memes in Bengali, English, and Hindi, each with cultural context notes. Evaluating 13 VLMs shows that providing cultural context improves performance (SBERT +11.8). Error analysis reveals closed-source models fail on entity identification, while open-source models lack cultural knowledge.
